svg.title: Binit echoes a key in 0.20 ms, like plain Readline; ble.sh takes 28.4 ms
svg.desc: Binit echoes a key in 0.20 ms, like plain Readline; ble.sh takes 28.4 ms. The slowest 1 in 100 keystrokes (p99), from key press to echo. Scored against ble.sh; plain Readline, which has no menu or suggestions, is reported. Typing a character: Binit 0.20 ms, ble.sh 28.4 ms, Plain Readline 0.21 ms. Deleting a character: Binit 0.23 ms, ble.sh 83.9 ms, Plain Readline 0.22 ms. Binit 0.1.0 on one Linux machine: Ryzen 7 7800X3D, GNU Bash 5.3.20.
